rationale: C01 owns measurement, units, calibration and uncertainty; C12 applies them in computational, medical and sensor contexts.
C02 owns classical mechanics; C12 applies it in biophysical, geophysical and device contexts.
C04 owns thermodynamics/statistical physics; C12 applies it in atmosphere, biology and energy systems.
C06 owns electromagnetism and circuits; C12 applies them in imaging, energy and sensors.
Continuum mechanics is contextual support for atmosphere, geophysics and transport but is not a canonical C12 prerequisite.
Chemistry, Earth/Universe and information/computation families remain future ownership boundaries and supply no support Claim IDs.
Modeling and measurement discipline support applied-domain reasoning while each topic retains its own physical focus.
